summary: Hiker cliffed out just below the summit of Ellingwood Point called for help and stayed put overnight in contact with dispatch; an AVSAR hasty team made contact at first light and hiked him down to South Zapata Lake.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search & Rescue (AVSAR); Alamosa County Sheriff's Office; Care Connect Helicopter (La Junta)
notes: AVSAR mission log 'Cliffed Out Hiker on Ellingwood Point - Sept. 10-11, 2021'; located via cell-phone signal; stayed put through a cold night, walked out to South Zapata Lake.
